elevenlabsPrompt:
[firm] Stop wondering if your passwords leaked. Chrome can tell you.

[confident] Here's the fix. Run Password Checkup.

[friendly] Open Chrome Settings, then Autofill and passwords. Open Password Manager, then Checkup. Change the compromised ones first.

[delighted] Now you know exactly which passwords to change.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
